LengthExpr.description: A length: a number in the design's length unit, or an expression such as "w / 2" or "30 mm".

Point2.description: A sketch point in mm: [x, y] or {"x", "y"}.

input.description: Make text in the sketch being edited: outlines that stay linked to their words and style, so a later sketch.edit_text can change them. Give `text` or `text_expression`, and `at`.

align.description:
The lines against `at`, or along the path: left, center (or centre) or right, either case.
Default: left. When editing, kept when left out.

angle.description:
The direction of the baseline, counter-clockwise from sketch X: a number of degrees or an
expression. Default: 0. When editing, kept when left out. Does not turn a text on a `path`.

at.description:
The baseline start, [x, y] in mm, or {x, y}; in `[x, y]` each is a number or an expression
over the design's parameters as a string (`"plate_width / 2"`), which the text keeps and
follows. Needed to make a text; when editing, kept when left out (and moving a text
replaces its expressions with numbers). Does not place a text on a `path`.

bold.description: An installed family's bold face. Default: false. When editing, kept when left out.

font.description:
An installed font's family or full name, or a .ttf or .otf file path (`~` and `%VAR%`
expand); empty: the built-in Liberation Sans. Default: the built-in font. When editing,
kept when left out.

height.description:
The capital height in mm (above 0, below 100 000), a number or an expression over the
design's parameters. Default: 5. When editing, kept when left out.

italic.description:
An installed family's italic face (without one, the text is slanted). Default: false. When
editing, kept when left out.

letter_spacing.description: Extra space between letters, in mm. Default: 0. When editing, kept when left out.

line_spacing.description:
The line distance as a multiple of the font's (above 0). Default: 1. When editing, kept
when left out.

path.description:
A curve id of the sketch the baseline follows; empty: none. `at` and `angle` then do not
place the text, and the curve becomes construction, a guide the letters stand on. When
editing, kept when left out.

reverse.description:
Run the text the other way along its `path`. Default: false. When editing, kept when left
out.

sketch.description: Only for the reply's `created`, which compares this sketch (default: the one being edited); the text always goes into the sketch being edited.

text.description:
The words, at most 4096 characters, `\n` breaking lines; not blank. Not with
`text_expression`. When editing, kept when left out.

text_expression.description:
The words built from text parameters (`parameters.add` with unit text), number parameters
and quoted texts joined by `+` (`"Label + '-L'"`, `"'W' + Width"`; `number(Width, 2)` is
a number with 2 decimals). The text keeps it and follows the parameters; the reply's
`exprs` returns it as `text`. Not with `text`. When editing, typed words replace it.

input.title: SketchTextParams

label: Text

TextExpressions.description: The expressions behind a text's numbers and words.

output.description: What `sketch.text` returns, and `sketch.edit_text` for one text.

created.description: What it added: `{points, curves, constraints, dimensions}`.

exprs.description: The expressions the text keeps; absent when it keeps none.

guide.description:
The curve the text follows that became construction, a guide the letters stand on; null
when none did.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

output.title: TextResult

params: text: string (\n breaks lines), or text_expression: the words built from text parameters (parameters.add with unit text), number parameters and quoted texts joined by + ("Label + '-L'", "'W' + Width"; a number parameter shows its value in the design's units, "85 mm", an angle in degrees, "30°"; number(Width) is the number alone and number(Width, 2) has 2 decimals): the text keeps it, its words follow the parameters (a parameter edit or a configuration row relabels it) and `exprs` returns it as `text`; at: baseline start [x,y], height?: capital height mm (default 5), angle?: deg; at's x and y, height and angle each take a number or an expression over the design's parameters as a string ("plate_width / 2", "label_size"): the text keeps the expression, follows the parameters, and returns it in `exprs`; an expression naming no parameter is the number it comes to, a bare number in one is in the design's units, font?: an installed font's family or full name, or a .ttf/.otf file path (~ and %VAR% expand; default: the built-in Liberation Sans), bold?, italic?: bool (an installed family's bold or italic face; italic without one is slanted), align?: left|center|right (the lines against `at`, or along the path), vertical_align?: baseline|top|middle|bottom (the block of lines against `at` or the path: the first line's baseline (default), its capitals' tops, halfway between those and the last line's baseline, or the bottom of the last line's descenders), letter_spacing?: extra mm between letters, line_spacing?: times the font's line distance (default 1), path?: a curve id of the sketch the baseline follows ("": none; `at` and `angle` then do not place the text; the curve becomes construction, a guide the letters stand on), reverse?: bool (the other way along the path). Returns created: {points, curves, constraints, dimensions}: the ids of what it added (stable and never reused: usable right away in sketch.dimension, sketch.constraint.*, sketch.delete…)
